self.text: Hey, I’m Omar, a Korean in my early 20s who’s still figuring out what it means to be non‑binary. I play Skyforge Arena on my handheld, and lately it’s all about those quick, casual matches; I love the fast pace and the chance to experiment without the pressure of ranked play. I stick to text chat – it’s my way of staying focused and still being part of the team. Most of the time I land in a support role, because I enjoy weaving buffs and healing while keeping an eye on the battlefield. I’m looking for someone who can coach me; I’m eager to improve my timing and positioning, and I appreciate a patient, step‑by‑step walkthrough style. When I’m not gaming I’m learning to sail, which gives me a sense of freedom and a quiet escape from the screen. I’m usually free on Saturday mornings or in the evenings on weekdays, so that’s when I can jump into a game and get some practice. Outside of the game, I love strolling along the seaside, watching the waves, and thinking about how everything moves in its own rhythm.
